item.title: Pmitz
item.description: Pmitz is our open-source toolkit for developers to enforce subscriptions and usage limits in multi-tenant applications, available as a Java library or a remote server. GitHub: https://github.com/terpomo-io/pmitz What it does Gate features by subscription and plan Enforce count limits and calendar-period rate limits Override limits per user, subscription, or directory group Store usage in JDBC databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server) Run embedded in your app or as a Spring Boot server with API key auth Install Maven:
